task_text: Find the white stained glass structure and mine at least 6 blocks using your Silk Touch pickaxe, then craft them into glass panes at the crafting table. Also find the stone brick wall landmark and mine the red concrete powder deposit behind it.
design_notes: The Silk Touch enchantment is critical — without it, stained glass drops nothing when mined. The player needs 6 white stained glass blocks to craft 16 white_stained_glass_panes (3x2 recipe on crafting table). 27 glass blocks are available (more than enough). The stone_brick_wall serves as a visual landmark/barrier leading to the red_concrete_powder deposit behind it. Red concrete powder drops itself when mined with any tool. All structures are within 15 blocks of spawn. NOTE: Crafting white_stained_glass produces white_stained_glass_pane (not regular glass_pane) — milestone should check for this item.
